class: content — the 20-paper validation slice (the lane acceptance of the rollout plan §3 Lane B)
method: MG's public papers index harvested read-only (83 Edexcel GCSE maths slugs); the 20-slice paper pages parsed from the RSC payload (the paperUrl/markSchemeUrl/paperAssetId); the QP+MS PDFs fetched read-only from the MG CDN (content-hashed filenames) and sha256-pinned in harvest-log.json; MG's PUBLIC pdfMarking.getRegions fetched per paper (the run-001-verified endpoint, documentRef paper_asset) as the validation oracle — the payloads checked in as lane artifacts (MG's region DATA, not document bytes; the PDFs/PNGs stay sandbox-local)
instrument: extract_rects2.py — run-001's anchor laws generalized: (1) the MS mark column anchors to the page's own header word 'Mark' (the column x drifts between sessions; run-001's fixed 235..300 band fit only the Jun-2025 layout); (2) the MS parses as a top-ordered EVENT stream (question numbers, part labels at x 85..145, mark codes) with each code binding to the latest label at or above its top +4pt (the label/code vertical alignment drifts between sessions); (3) the split-code law (some sessions kern 'B1' into 'B'+'1' — joined in-band); (4) the parenthesized-code law (the MS's own alternative-branch notation '(C2' parses as C2 with the alt flag; the branch-collapse pops the explicit alternatives FIRST, then run-001's last-row rule); (5) the page-span law (parts may anchor on the page AFTER their question header — run-001's paper had none; part rects carry their own page); (6) the per-paper x-band calibration from the oracle's question/part rect extents (run-001's bands were oracle-derived too — disclosed as CALIBRATION; the y/height/page evidence stays independent); (7) the deficit-capped recovery pass (a question under its footer re-scans its own table span for dropped codes; never over-counts; every recovered row disclosed)

gates.G1_census_vs_footer: 17/20 exact; the 3 residues are ONE mark each, named per question in question_mark_diffs (Jun2025 3F q17/q23, Jun2025 3H q18, Nov2023 1F q19) — the MS-faithful rows still ship for every captured code
gates.oracle: supporting evidence, NOT the gate: MG's region geometry is content-adaptive per region (their widths vary 0.786..0.928), so the strict agreement ranges 68..96% (mean 83%) with ZERO page mismatches across all 20 papers; run-001's 63/64 was one paper where the bands coincided
gates.visual: 8 spot-check crops rendered (rects drawn on the QP pages: 2F Jun2025 p2/p3, 2H Jun2024 p2/p3, 1F Nov2023 p2/p3, 3H Nov2024 p2/p3); 2 reviewed in-session — the question blocks land exactly on their footers, the furniture excluded (sandbox-local, not committed)

deliverables.manifests: apps/api/scripts/fixtures/mark-point-rects-1ma1-<tier>-<session>.json (20 files, each sha256-pinned in the test — hand edits fail loudly)
deliverables.lane_artifacts: .syllabai/lane-artifacts/T-MG-MP-RECT-2/run-002/ (the instrument + the harvest log + the extraction summary + the marks crosscheck + the 20 oracle payloads)

discipline: zero writes to the target site (read-only GETs of public assets, the dossier precedent); zero DB contact (the seed is deployment-time, --dry-run loud-fail); additive-only repo diff (the fixtures + the test + the lane artifacts)
